responsibility: Validates the `intern` module’s `Interned` comparison semantics by testing that equality is determined by interned identity/address and that `Ord`/`PartialOrd` short-circuit equal interned values without invoking the wrapped type’s equality logic, even when value-level uniqueness assumptions are violated.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `tests.rs` files, this one is about interning identity semantics: it verifies that `Interned` equality and ordering short-circuit on shared address identity and do not rely on underlying value comparisons in equal-identity cases.
